stories.headline: Weymouth made it 13 wins from 15 to start the season with a comfortable 0-5…
stories.body: Weymouth made it 13 wins from 15 to start the season with a comfortable 0-5 win at Slimbridge . Toby Holmes moved his season tally to 14 in the league with a hat-trick, while Lewis Brown and Calvin Brooks grabbed the other two.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | The top eight all win in the Division One Central, Melksham Town with a dramatic late comeback win, and Bury Town back to winning ways
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: A huge result for fourth place Westbury United as they came from behind to beat…
stories.body: A huge result for fourth place Westbury United as they came from behind to beat third place Dorchester Town 2-1. Ethan Taylor’s 12th of the season had Dorchester ahead, before Jensen Wakefield and Ben Sarr turned the game around, moving the White Horse Men two points behind the Magpies, having played a game extra.

stories.headline: Hungerford Town remain fifth with games in hand on all sides in the play-offs, after…
stories.body: Hungerford Town remain fifth with games in hand on all sides in the play-offs, after they overcame Worcester Raiders 2-0, with the visitors from yesterday afternoon in 10th. Melksham Town came from behind to pick up an impressive three points at home to sixth place Falmouth Town , who missed a injury time penalty, moving Melksham off the bottom and into 20th with their third win of the season.

stories.headline: A 0-2 win for 12th place Willand Rovers saw Bristol Manor Farm slip to the…
stories.body: A 0-2 win for 12th place Willand Rovers saw Bristol Manor Farm slip to the foot of the table, with Manor Farm manager Will Justin resigning after the game. Bristol Manor Farm can confirm that Will Justin has tendered his resignation as First-Team Manager, following Saturday’s fixture against Willand Rovers.

stories.headline: Exmouth Town got back to winning ways with a 2-0 victory over Paulton Rovers …
stories.body: Exmouth Town got back to winning ways with a 2-0 victory over Paulton Rovers , a first win in six, thanks to a brace from Aarron Denny either side of half-time, lifting Town to 14th.
